Hi Susan — thanks for the note and the VAT cert. Short answer: yes, we can do portal primary with an email fanout during a limited ramp window.

Proposal (internal + external):
- Primary emitter: Redwood portal (invoices visible in customer portal, API push enabled).
- Temporary fanout: send PDF copy to ap@brightlane.com and susan.arnold@brightlane.com for 90 days post go-live. After 90 days we move to portal-only unless Brightlane requests continuation.
- Invoice rota / sender identity: Redwood will sign invoices from invoices@billing.redwood.ai. For specific legal entity head (multi-entity customers) we can rotate emitters by ledger; we suggest Redwood keep a single canonical sender for the first quarter to avoid AP matching issues.
- VAT evidence: we will store VAT certificate files in the customer's secure evidence store (read-only for the customer) and reference them on the invoice metadata for EU reconciliation. If you need VAT certs attached to PDF invoices, we can include a footer note and a link to the stored evidence.

Action items:
1) Kimberly — confirm emitter email and SFTP / API push credentials we should use.
2) Connor — share the mapping for PO exceptions and how AP exceptions will be handled when an invoice comes via email vs portal.
3) Susan / Brightlane — confirm the 90-day email fanout window and any additional AP addresses to include.

If that works I can loop in GTM ops to schedule a 20-minute handoff to sign off on the mapping and cutover date.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
